hook: One-shot channel simulation costs I + log I + a constant bits, and that constant is proved optimal.
summary: The paper proves a tight bound on the entropy left over when one party simulates a channel using shared randomness, with the third-order constant shown unimprovable. It also shows the Poisson functional representation is within a constant gap of optimal. The result is theoretical and concerns the one-shot setting, with no implementation.
title: The Optimal Constant for One-Shot Channel Simulation and Strong Functional Representation Lemma
